FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Lead Technician, Appliance Pros Sales & Repair, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@appliancepros.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Appliance Pros Sales & Repair, we specialize in the retail sale and repair of various household appliances, including refrigerators, washers, dryers, and kitchen appliances. Our operations are anchored by a physical storefront located in Springfield, where customers can browse our wide selection of high-quality appliances from reputable brands. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional customer service and support, offering knowledgeable advice on product selection as well as expert installation and repair services. Our dedicated team of certified technicians is trained in manufacturer protocols to ensure that all installations and repairs are performed to the highest standards. We maintain a secure and organized inventory storage area to protect our products, and we conduct all operations within the guidelines set for operational safety and liability exposure. Additionally, our administrative staff utilizes a digital management system to keep records of all sales, repairs, and customer interactions up-to-date. We are committed to compliance with safety standards and local regulations, effectively positioning us as a trusted partner in the appliance industry.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: January 10, 2023; Cause: Water damage due to a burst pipe in the shop; Amount: $2,000.00; Status: Claim filed and approved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Centrally monitored alarm system with security patrols during non-business hours.
